cells.gaps: No source states a town hall (mairie) connected and in use: PADCI's connection of mairies is planned for 2025-2030 with no count, and the EU-funded CIVIPOL town-hall project is called ongoing with no office said to be on it. CIV-018 (systems: birth data sent in real time to civil-status offices in mairies) and CIV-016 (targeted mairies have no internet) disagree, and CIV-018 does not describe the mairie's own connection; CIV-016 speaks of the mairies the component targets, not of all, so it is not a statement of absence. ANSUT's national broadband network (CIV-019) aims from 2025 to link mairies, with a 1,500 km pilot stretch, and states no mairie connected.
cells.note: A financed programme to connect mairies is being prepared, which is the stage 2 row. Stage 3 needs an institutional connection live in some local governments outside the capital, and no fact states one.
